limitations: No population/year inference from Wikidata. Earlier ledgers prove codes, not current population.
Integral parts of one basic locality may enter its census total; any other basic locality forces a hold.
Local MySQL cannot start after Homebrew upgraded the binary beyond the data-folder version; MySQL check skipped, no repair/initialisation attempted.
BDL help terms/license URLs return an unavailable-page body; those are not relied on as terms. Full GUS reuse and copyright pages plus official BDL dataset licence are the reuse evidence.
